solutions.title: Active Comp Context Review

intent.summary: Inspect active composition, selected layers and optional render queue state without changing the project.
appliesWhen: The user asks to summarize the active comp, selected layers or render queue state.
The planner needs compact read-only context before deciding whether a later mutation is safe.

targetAssumptions: The CEP panel may be offline; offline context should be reported instead of guessed.

verificationRecipe.summary: Confirm the plan uses only typed read tools and reports returned context or offline state.

notes: Seeded from the Project Context Snapshot workflow and offline prompt smoke coverage.

promotionHistory.evidence: Milestone 71 seed from existing read-only context snapshot and prompt smoke validation.

notes: This recipe is advisory context only and must not add mutation steps.

solutions.title: Basic Comp Setup Typed Plan

intent.summary: Create one basic composition with explicit size, duration and frame rate, then read it back.
appliesWhen: The user asks to create a simple or basic composition.
The planner needs a narrow comp creation pattern before adding layers or effects.

inputs.name: compName
inputs.description: Requested composition name.

inputs.name: compSettings
inputs.description: Explicit width, height, duration, frame rate and optional background color.

targetAssumptions: The requested comp is a new generated project item.
The workflow does not require broad comp updates or template batch changes.

verificationRecipe.summary: Read back the created comp and confirm name, dimensions, duration and frame rate.
steps: Run get_comp_details after create_comp.
Compare the returned comp metadata with the requested settings.
expectedEvidence: The created comp reports the expected name, size, duration and frame rate.
The mutating step includes idempotency and read-back verification.

notes: Seeded as a Dakkshin-inspired advisory recipe using existing create_comp typed-tool coverage.

promotionHistory.evidence: Milestone 187 advisory solution-library slice from M186 recommended help/prompt entries.

notes: Advisory recipe only; execution still uses normal Agent plan validation and protected run gates.

solutions.title: Safe Effect Addition Typed Plan

intent.summary: Add an effect to a verified layer with matchName-oriented discovery and effect read-back.
appliesWhen: The user asks to add an effect safely to a selected or explicit layer.
The planner needs effect property details before changing effect values.

inputs.name: targetLayer
inputs.description: Selected layer or explicit layer target verified before adding the effect.

inputs.name: effectMatchName
inputs.description: Known effect matchName; omit when discovery must run first.

targetAssumptions: An active composition exists.
The target layer is selected or explicitly identified before mutation.

verificationRecipe.summary: Read back the effect instance and, when properties change, verify the exact property target before and after mutation.
steps: Run get_effect_details after add_effect.
Use set_effect_property only after get_effect_details identifies the target property.
Run get_effect_details again after property mutation.
expectedEvidence: The expected effect is present on the verified layer.
Any property change uses property evidence from get_effect_details.

notes: Seeded as a Dakkshin-inspired advisory recipe using existing effect typed-tool coverage.

promotionHistory.evidence: Milestone 187 advisory solution-library slice from M186 recommended help/prompt entries.

notes: The recipe prefers matchName/read-back and must not use display-name-only raw execution.

solutions.title: Effect Template Chain Typed Plan

intent.summary: Apply a reviewed whitelisted effect template or effect chain to a verified layer with typed effect read-back.
appliesWhen: The user asks for gaussian-blur, directional-blur, color-balance, brightness-contrast, glow, drop-shadow, cinematic-look, or text-pop.
The planner needs a fixed effect-template chain without raw JSX, arbitrary presets, or unknown template names.
Simple effect properties can be set only after get_effect_details identifies the exact property target.

inputs.name: targetLayer
inputs.description: Selected layer or explicit layer target verified before adding any template effects.

inputs.name: templateName
inputs.description: One reviewed whitelist value: gaussian-blur, directional-blur, color-balance, brightness-contrast, glow, drop-shadow, cinematic-look, or text-pop.

inputs.name: customSettings
inputs.description: Optional simple numeric, boolean, or RGBA settings to apply only after typed property evidence.

targetAssumptions: An active composition exists.
The target layer is selected or explicitly identified before mutation.
Standalone curves and curve point/channel edits are out of scope.

verificationRecipe.summary: Read back every added effect and property mutation for the whitelisted template chain.
steps: Run get_active_comp and get_selected_layers or equivalent explicit target evidence before mutation.
Run add_effect for each whitelisted effect matchName in template order.
Run get_effect_details after each add_effect and before any property mutation.
Run set_effect_property only for exact property targets identified by get_effect_details.
Run final get_effect_details and get_layer_details read-back.
expectedEvidence: The expected effect matchNames are present on the verified layer in the requested template chain.
Any property change uses exact property evidence from get_effect_details before and after mutation.
Standalone curves, unknown templates, and ambiguous properties are recorded as fail-closed.

notes: Seeded as a Dakkshin-inspired advisory recipe using existing effect typed-tool coverage.

promotionHistory.evidence: Milestone 187 Dakkshin missing-nuance closeout adapted only the fixed applyEffectTemplate whitelist into typed add_effect/get_effect_details/set_effect_property guidance; raw JSX, standalone curves, unknown templates, and arbitrary presets remain fail-closed.

notes: Use only whitelisted template names and effect matchNames.
ADBE CurvesCustom is allowed only as the unconfigured first effect in cinematic-look; curve point/channel edits need a separate contract.
Unknown template names, arbitrary effect chains, and display-name-only property writes fail closed.

solutions.title: Add Fill With Color Cycle Typed Plan

intent.summary: Apply ADBE Fill with one reviewed palette color on explicit generated or reviewed layer targets, without source-exact persistent color-cycle state.
appliesWhen: The user asks to add Fill with a color-cycle style result to selected or explicit layers.
A stateless typed adaptation is acceptable: the plan uses one reviewed color from red, green, blue, yellow, magenta or cyan for this run.
Source-exact app.settings/app.preferences persistence and automatic cross-run color advancement are not required.

inputs.name: targetLayers
inputs.description: Current typed evidence identifying the target comp and exact selected or explicit layer indices before mutation.

inputs.name: cycleColor
inputs.description: Reviewed RGB or RGBA value chosen from the allowed cycle palette: red, green, blue, yellow, magenta or cyan.

targetAssumptions: Every mutated layer is generated or explicitly reviewed through current typed evidence before mutation.
The workflow adds an ADBE Fill effect and changes only its Color property on the explicit targets.
The plan displays the reviewed cycle color before confirmation and does not infer the next color from persistent AE settings.

AE app.settings/app.preferences reads or writes, automatic cross-run cycle advancement, layer source/timing/expression/keyframe changes, project item changes, render queue work, and unrelated effects are preserved.

verificationRecipe.summary: Bind explicit target layers, add ADBE Fill, inspect the Fill Color property, set the reviewed cycle color, then read the same effect and layer back.
steps: Run get_active_comp and get_selected_layers or equivalent generated get_comp_details evidence before mutation.
Fail closed if target layer evidence is empty, stale, not generated or not explicitly reviewed.
Show the reviewed cycle color and disclose that app.settings/app.preferences persistence is out of scope.
Run add_effect with matchName ADBE Fill for each explicit target layer.
Run get_effect_details with includeProperties:true and includeValues:true for every added Fill effect.
Run set_effect_property only after get_effect_details identifies the Fill Color property, using setAtTime:false.
Run get_effect_details and get_layer_details after mutation to confirm the same effect, property and layer targets.
expectedEvidence: Pre-run evidence identifies the target comp, target layer names/indices and reviewed cycle color.
add_effect and get_effect_details show ADBE Fill on each expected layer.
set_effect_property and post-run get_effect_details show the reviewed color value on the Fill Color property.
get_layer_details confirms the target layers remain the intended layers.

notes: Built as a generated-only stateless adaptation after scoped Full Intaker review of Layers/Add_Fill_With_Color_Cycle.jsx.

promotionHistory.evidence: Adapted only the typed effect-property part of reviewed external AE script collection Layers/Add_Fill_With_Color_Cycle.jsx into existing add_effect/get_effect_details/set_effect_property coverage. Source-exact app.settings/app.preferences color-cycle persistence remains fail-closed.

notes: Do not claim source-exact persistent color-cycle behavior without a separate settings-state typed contract and preference rollback.
Do not use raw JSX, app.settings, app.preferences, broad selected-layer traversal, unreviewed user layers or unreviewed effect/property targets.

solutions.title: Toggle Specific Effects Typed Plan

intent.summary: Enable or disable one explicit applied effect instance using set_effect_enabled and typed read-back.
appliesWhen: The user asks to toggle, enable or disable a specific applied effect.
Current typed evidence identifies the target comp, exact layer index/name, effect identity and current effect.enabled state.
The desired final enabled state is reviewed before mutation.
whenNotToUse: The request needs source-exact project-wide traversal, Alt-key behavior, broad selected-layer scans, fuzzy effect matching, unreviewed user effects, third-party semantics, effect addition/removal/reordering, property edits, raw JSX, file I/O or render queue work.

inputs.name: targetEffect
inputs.description: Concrete comp, layerIndex, effectIndex/effectName/effectMatchName, and current effect.enabled evidence.

inputs.name: enabled
inputs.description: Reviewed final enabled state for the target effect instance.

targetAssumptions: Every mutated effect is on a generated or explicitly reviewed layer.
Effect identity is matched by exact effectIndex, effectName, and/or effectMatchName evidence from list_effects or get_effect_details.
The workflow mutates only effect.enabled on the explicit effect target.

Source-exact all-project traversal, broad selected-layer matching, Alt-key branching, unreviewed user effects, third-party effect semantics, property edits, effect removal/reordering, non-generated user assets, and raw JSX remain fail-closed.

verificationRecipe.summary: Bind one explicit effect target, set effect.enabled to the reviewed final state, then read the same effect and layer back.
steps: Run get_active_comp or use an explicit comp target before mutation.
Run get_selected_layers, list_layers or get_comp_details to bind concrete layer indices and names.
Run list_effects or get_effect_details to bind exact effect identity and current effect.enabled state.
Run set_effect_enabled with the explicit effect target, reviewed enabled value, and expectedCurrentEnabled when available.
Run get_effect_details after mutation and confirm the same effect identity plus final enabled state.
Run get_layer_details after mutation and confirm the target layer still owns the intended effect.
expectedEvidence: Pre-run evidence identifies comp, layer index/name, effect index/name/matchName, current enabled state, and reviewed final state.
set_effect_enabled reports postVerification.enabledMatches:true for the same effect identity.
Post-run get_effect_details shows the same effect with the requested enabled value.
Post-run get_layer_details shows the target layer still owns the intended effect.

notes: Built as a generated-only adaptation after scoped Full Intaker review of Layers/Toggle_Specific_Effects.jsx.

promotionHistory.evidence: Adapted only the specific-effect enabled-state intent into set_effect_enabled with exact generated layer/effect identity, before/after get_effect_details, get_layer_details read-back and semantic verification; no source JSX copied. Project-wide traversal, Alt-key branching, broad selected-layer scans, unreviewed user effects, third-party effect semantics, effect addition/removal/reordering, property edits and raw JSX remain fail-closed.

notes: Prefer explicit enable or disable final state over ambiguous toggle wording.
Use set_effect_enabled only after list_effects or get_effect_details has identified one exact effect instance.
Do not mutate effect properties, add/remove/reorder effects, scan the full project, rely on source selection side effects, or target unreviewed user effects.

solutions.title: Text Layer Justification Typed Plan

intent.summary: Create or update a generated/reviewed text layer with left, center, or right paragraph justification using typed TextDocument tools and read-back.
appliesWhen: The user asks to create left, center, or right aligned text, or change a reviewed text layer's paragraph alignment.
The target composition is explicit and update targets have current typed text-layer evidence.
The requested alignment can be normalized to left, center, or right.
whenNotToUse: The request needs full justify, vertical text, paragraph box dimensions, baseline or anchor inference, text animators, expression/keyframe edits, source-exact selection or stack placement, arbitrary TextDocument fields, raw JSX, file I/O, or render queue work.

inputs.name: targetTextLayer
inputs.description: For updates, current get_layer_details or get_comp_details evidence identifying one text layer by comp, layerIndex, and expected name/source text when available.

inputs.name: justification
inputs.description: Reviewed paragraph justification: left, center, or right.

targetAssumptions: New text layers are generated or explicitly named before mutation.
Existing text layers are updated only after typed text-layer evidence identifies the exact layer.
Only TextDocument paragraph justification is changed unless other covered create_text_layer/update_text_layer fields are explicitly reviewed.
Full justification, arbitrary TextDocument mutation, text animators, selection side effects, raw JSX, and non-generated user assets remain fail-closed.

verificationRecipe.summary: Normalize the reviewed justification to left/center/right, create or update one explicit text layer, then read back text.justification.
steps: Run get_active_comp or get_comp_details to bind the target composition.
For updates, run get_layer_details first and confirm the target is a text layer.
Run create_text_layer or update_text_layer with justification left, center, or right.
Run get_layer_details after mutation and verify text.justification matches the reviewed value.
Fail closed for full justify, arbitrary TextDocument fields, broad layer scans, non-generated user assets, raw JSX, file I/O, and render queue work.
expectedEvidence: Pre-run evidence identifies comp and text layer target when updating.
Mutation uses create_text_layer or update_text_layer with justification:left|center|right.
Post-run get_layer_details shows matching text.justification on the same layer.
Unsupported source-exact alignment behavior is reported as a typed-tool gap.

notes: Seeded by Dakkshin/TheLlamainator final-gaps closeout for createTextLayer paragraph alignment.

promotionHistory.evidence: Milestone 187 follow-up added bounded create_text_layer/update_text_layer justification support for left, center, and right ParagraphJustification with semantic verification and plan-repair alias coverage; no raw JSX copied.

notes: Use only left, center, or right paragraph justification.
Require get_layer_details read-back before claiming success.
Do not generalize this recipe to arbitrary TextDocument edits, full justification, source-exact selection behavior, or non-generated user assets.

solutions.title: Shape Layer Polystar Typed Plan

intent.summary: Create generated or explicitly reviewed polygon and star shape layers with bounded typed geometry and shapeContents read-back.
appliesWhen: The user asks to create a polygon or star shape layer.
The target composition is explicit and the requested geometry can be reviewed as points and radii.
The plan can use create_shape_layer without raw JSX, source checkout scripts, arbitrary vector path edits, or hidden native defaults.
whenNotToUse: The request needs arbitrary vector path vertices, roundness, trim paths, repeaters, expressions, source temp-args wrappers, selection side effects, non-generated user-asset mutation without review, file I/O, raw JSX, or render queue work.

inputs.name: targetComposition
inputs.description: Current get_active_comp/get_comp_details evidence, compName, or compItemIndex for one explicit target composition.

inputs.name: shape
inputs.description: Reviewed shape type: polygon or star.

inputs.name: pointsAndRadii
inputs.description: Reviewed integer points from 3 to 64, positive outerRadius, and star innerRadius lower than outerRadius when applicable.

targetAssumptions: New polygon/star layers are generated or explicitly named before mutation.
Polygon/star geometry is represented only by create_shape_layer shape, points, outerRadius, and star innerRadius.
Post-mutation get_layer_details or get_comp_details exposes shapeContents for read-back.
Raw JSX, source wrappers, arbitrary vector path editing, hidden native defaults, and non-generated user assets remain fail-closed.

verificationRecipe.summary: Create one reviewed polygon or star layer with create_shape_layer, then read back shapeContents.
steps: Run get_active_comp or get_comp_details to bind the target composition.
Run create_shape_layer with shape polygon or star, explicit points, outerRadius, and star innerRadius when applicable.
Run get_layer_details or get_comp_details after mutation and verify shapeContents type/starType, points, outerRadius, and innerRadius for stars.
Fail closed for rectangle/ellipse size confusion, arbitrary path vertices, raw JSX, source wrappers, file I/O, broad scans, and unreviewed user assets.
expectedEvidence: Pre-run evidence identifies one explicit target composition and generated/reviewed layer name.
Mutation uses create_shape_layer with bounded polygon/star geometry only.
Post-run read-back shows matching shapeContents.type/starType, points, outerRadius, and star innerRadius when applicable.
Unsupported source-exact polygon/star behavior is reported as a typed-tool gap.

notes: Seeded by Dakkshin/TheLlamainator final-gaps closeout for createShapeLayer polygon/star support.

promotionHistory.evidence: Milestone 187 final-gaps follow-up added bounded create_shape_layer polygon/star support with points/radii validation, compact shapeContents read-back, and semantic verification; no raw JSX copied.

notes: Use explicit points and radii for polygon/star requests.
Require get_layer_details or get_comp_details shapeContents read-back before claiming success.
Do not generalize this recipe to arbitrary vector paths, trim/repeater/roundness edits, source wrappers, selection side effects, or non-generated user assets.

solutions.title: Transfer Composition Work Area Typed Plan

intent.summary: Transfer reviewed workAreaStart and workAreaDuration values from one composition to another through typed read-back and a narrow work-area mutation.
appliesWhen: The user asks to copy, paste, transfer, or apply a composition work area from one composition to another.
A safe typed adaptation is acceptable instead of persistent app.settings clipboard behavior or Alt-key branching.

inputs.name: sourceComp
inputs.description: Composition whose current workAreaStart and workAreaDuration are read before mutation.

inputs.name: targetComp
inputs.description: Composition whose work area will be set after source and target evidence are reviewed.

inputs.name: copiedWorkArea
inputs.description: Reviewed start and duration values copied from source get_comp_details evidence.

targetAssumptions: Source and target composition identities are read from current typed evidence before mutation.
The copied work area comes from source get_comp_details workAreaStart and workAreaDuration evidence.
The workflow changes only the verified target composition workAreaStart and workAreaDuration fields through set_comp_work_area.
The copied range is checked against the target composition duration and frameRate before mutation.

Persistent app.settings clipboard behavior, ScriptUI Alt-key branching, hidden cross-session state, marker-derived work areas, current-time inference, layer retiming, duration changes and exact source JSX behavior remain typed-tool gaps.

verificationRecipe.summary: Read source and target composition details, set only the target work area to the copied source range, then read the target back.
steps: Run get_active_comp only when the current active composition is used as source or target; otherwise bind explicit comp item/name evidence.
Run get_comp_details for the source composition before mutation and record workAreaStart, workAreaDuration, duration, frameRate, width, height, bgColor and layer count.
Run get_comp_details for the target composition before mutation and record duration, frameRate, current workAreaStart, current workAreaDuration, width, height, bgColor and layer count.

Normalize the copied source workAreaStart and workAreaDuration to finite seconds values and fail closed when the range is outside the target comp duration, missing, ambiguous, marker-derived, current-time-derived, or off-frame where frame precision matters.
Run set_comp_work_area once against the verified target composition with only copied start, copied duration, verifyAfter and idempotency evidence.
Run get_comp_details after mutation and compare target workAreaStart and workAreaDuration plus unchanged duration, frameRate, width, height, bgColor and layer count.
When source and target differ, read the source composition again or preserve pre-run evidence showing it was not intentionally mutated.
expectedEvidence: Pre-run source get_comp_details shows the copied workAreaStart and copied workAreaDuration.
Pre-run target get_comp_details shows the target duration and frameRate used for bounds review.
Dry-run evidence lists the copied workAreaStart, copied workAreaDuration, target bounds check, and the decision not to reproduce app.settings clipboard or Alt-key branching.
The set_comp_work_area step updates only the work area on the verified target composition.
Post-run get_comp_details shows the copied workAreaStart and copied workAreaDuration on the same target comp with unchanged width, height, duration, frameRate, bgColor and layer count.

The plan reports persistent settings clipboard, Alt-key paste branching, marker-derived work areas, current-time inference, layer retiming, duration changes and exact source JSX semantics as unsupported by current typed tools.

notes: Seeded by tool-compositions-transfer-composition-work-area generic repository importer as advisory typed-plan coverage for work-area transfer between explicit compositions.
Existing generated-only comp work-area proof covers set_comp_work_area with get_comp_details read-back; persistent settings clipboard and keyboard-state semantics remain fail-closed.

Persistent app.settings storage, Alt-key copy/paste branching, hidden cross-session clipboard state, marker-derived work areas, current-time inference, layer retiming, duration changes, native undo semantics and exact source JSX behavior require separate typed-tool contracts; parent importer owns validation and live acceptance.

notes: Advisory recipe only; execution still uses normal Agent plan validation, dry-run/run gates, checkpoint/edit-session protection, idempotency, and read-back verification.
This recipe copies workAreaStart and workAreaDuration from typed source evidence and mutates only the verified target composition work area.

Do not use this recipe for persistent app.settings clipboard storage, Alt-key keyboard branching, cross-session state, marker-derived work-area inference, current-time inference, layer retiming, duration changes, source relinking, render queue items, project item changes, or raw ExtendScript.

solutions.title: Read Composition Markers Typed Plan

intent.summary: Read composition-level markers from comp.markerProperty in keyTime order through get_comp_details includeMarkers evidence.
appliesWhen: The user asks to inspect, list, summarize, or reason from composition markers.
A later workflow needs explicit composition marker time/comment/duration evidence before any separate work-area or timing mutation is considered.

inputs.name: targetComp
inputs.description: Active or explicit composition verified by get_active_comp or get_comp_details before marker evidence is used.

inputs.name: markerLimit
inputs.description: Bounded maximum number of composition markers to return. Defaults to the get_comp_details markerLimit.

targetAssumptions: Composition marker evidence is read from get_comp_details with includeMarkers:true.
Returned markers.items are ordered by comp.markerProperty.keyTime and preserve keyIndex, time, comment, and duration when available.
The workflow is read-only and does not create, update, delete, or move markers.
Layer marker tools are not equivalent to composition marker reads.
Marker-derived work-area mutation remains a separate reviewed plan using explicit marker bounds plus set_comp_work_area.

verificationRecipe.summary: Read the explicit composition with includeMarkers:true and verify ordered composition marker evidence without mutation.
steps: Run get_active_comp only when the active composition is the target; otherwise bind explicit comp item/name evidence.
